description: Marauder system and radio toolkit for Cardputer Zero

store.summary: System diagnostics and radio toolkit for Cardputer Zero
store.description: A native C++ and LVGL Marauder port for Cardputer Zero. The current milestone adds keyboard-reachable bounded System Info pages, the classic Marauder menu, read-only diagnostics, adapter selection and capability reporting, and managed-mode Wi-Fi scanning; active radio features remain hardware-gated.
